heading: Assessment of mental capacity in civil and criminal proceedings
title: Assessment of mental capacity in civil and criminal proceedings
text: Where in any proceeding before a Civil or Criminal Court the mental condition or capacity of any party or accused person is questioned, the Court may order such person to be examined by a Medical Board comprising certified psychiatrists.
text_raw: Where in any proceeding before a Civil or Criminal Court the mental condition or capacity of any party or accused person is questioned, the Court may order such person to be examined by a Medical Board comprising certified psychiatrists.

heading: Judicial inquisition into unsoundness of mind and management of property
title: Judicial inquisition into unsoundness of mind and management of property
text: The Court of Session or District Judge may, on application, direct an inquisition whether a person subject to its jurisdiction is of unsound mind and incapable of managing his property, and appoint a manager of such estate.
